description: Install and load the per-solet macOS LaunchAgent so the solet starts at user login. The bound local self-deployment plugin renders the plist under ~/Library/LaunchAgents, unloads any stale loaded definition first, writes the fresh plist, and loads it through launchctl. dry_run reports the planned actions without writing or invoking launchctl.
embedding_description: Install macOS LaunchAgent autostart for the local solet. Writes and loads ~/Library/LaunchAgents/local.solet.<name>.plist, idempotently unloads stale definitions first, KeepAlive=false, RunAtLoad=true. Returns status, verb, solet_name, label, plist_path, prior_state, last_run_at, dry_run, and message.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: AutostartResult envelope with status, verb, solet_name, label, plist_path, prior_state, last_run_at, dry_run, and message.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with status. On success, surface label and plist_path. On dry_run, surface the planned action and prior_state. On failure, surface message verbatim.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Install and load a macOS LaunchAgent for solet autostart.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: launchctl errors usually mean malformed plist, stale loaded state, or file permission issues. filesystem errors mean the LaunchAgents directory or plist could not be written.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Rerun install_autostart after correcting permissions. If launchctl reports stale loaded state, rerun because the implementation unloads before loading.
